findings.why: The subject declares at failsIf[25] that it fails if 'speaker labels say This v1, This v2, This v3, This v4, or This v5 for this subject', and at failsIf[7] that it fails if 'v1, v2, v3, v4, or v5 is recorded as a current occupancy remasurement'. This one sentence trips both. It is a reader-routing rule, not a historical note: it defines who the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement after D-173 / D-230 is, and it answers 'v5'. That is the definition of recording v5 as the current occupancy remasurement. The subject is the live-HEAD occupancy remasurement after D-173 / D-230 -- it says so itself two sentences earlier in the same field: 'This v6 is occupancy remasurement of the unversioned identifier harness.DR-G01.core-download at live HEAD after leftover-join.v7 / required-now 28.' The same field therefore both claims and disclaims that role within three sentences, and hands the disclaimed half to a frozen predecessor. This directly contradicts doesNot[14] 'Does not record frozen v1, v2, v3, v4, or v5 as a current occupancy remasurement', basedOn.predecessorV5.role 'Not recordable as a current occupancy remasurement', proposedLaterWork[8] 'Frozen v5 remains a historical occupancy that was dual REJECT/ACCEPT. Do not record v5 as current', and the review prompt's standing constraint 'Do not record v1-v5 as a current occupancy remasurement'. It also defeats the purpose of CLAUDE-G01H-V5-SF1, which was landed in this very file to widen the currency roster to v4 and v5 so that v5 could not be read as current: the roster was widened while the routing sentence that actually routes readers to v5 as current was left standing.

observationsNotFindings: The harness content remains the strongest part of the artifact and must survive any repair verbatim. The five retainedEvidence members are the five live-cell members in live order, each exactByteIntent defers to unauthored fixtures, and EV-2 and EV-5 correctly refuse to score size against 25 MB before a D-006 unit successor exists. Both are byte-identical to v5.

Both MUST-FIX findings are single-token repairs ('this v5' to 'this v6') in two role strings. Neither touches harness content, retainedEvidence, recordedInputs, any verbatim quotation, or any pinned digest. A v7 that changes only those two tokens, plus the routine version/artifact/basedOn/currency bookkeeping, should be reviewable as clean.

This is the third consecutive occupancy successor rejected on incomplete speaker-label sweep residue: v4 carried v3 residue, v5 carried v4 residue (CLAUDE-G01H-V5-MF1), and v6 carries v5 residue. The recurrence is the point. A mechanical predecessor-check over the whole document -- assert that no 'this v<n>' with n less than the current version survives outside a quoted prior-defect condition -- would have caught all three, including both findings here, and would cost nothing to run before freezing. failsIf[28] shows the author already knows the one legitimate exception and can encode it.

The residual 'this v4' at failsIf[28] was tested and is correct: it quotes the prior defect condition inside the CLAUDE-G01H-V5-MF1 landing test, and rewriting it would destroy the test. It is not a speaker label and is not a finding.
